description: This file defines routing endpoints for managing 'organizations' within the backend API of a cloud resource management platform. It sets up RESTful routes with associated handlers, middleware for authentication and authorization, and contains Swagger documentation annotations for API specifications.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: List organizations for the current user, protected by authentication and error handling middleware.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Create a new organization, protected by authentication.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Retrieve details of an organization by ID, with authorization checks.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Update organization details, requiring admin role.

methods.name: router.get('/:id/members')
methods.description: List members of a specific organization.

methods.name: router.post('/:id/members')
methods.description: Add or update an organization member, admin-only.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id/members/:memberId')
methods.description: Remove a member from an organization, admin-only.
